items.title: Inkling 2 Mini: a new model you can run on your own machine
items.pitch: Thinking Machines put out a 26B small model and it got 1062 points on HN. If you want to try a local model, it's worth a look this weekend.
why: 1062 points on HN, lots of buzz
26B parameters, a good high-end PC might be able to run it
There's already a GGUF version (a common format for local models), with 238K downloads from Unsloth
actions: Check out the thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini page on Hugging Face
If you want to try it locally, look for unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF
deep_dive: Unlike Claude Code or codex, it's an open-weights model, so you can download it yourself and run it without calling an online service.
The sources only give a title and download numbers, so there's no way to tell what it can actually do. For your office work, a cloud model is easier. Running it locally is mostly for fun and privacy.
items.signals: HN 1062 points · 200 comments · #1 on HF trending · Unsloth GGUF 238K downloads

items.title: Control Antigravity from your phone with Neon
items.pitch: Peter Yang shared a small trick: add the Antigravity web page to your phone's home screen and you can remotely control the threads on your computer.
why: No app to install, only takes a few steps to set up
He thinks it works better than Claude's remote control, because all your threads are there
